title: Salesforce is saying bye to AI as Trump's rebrand picks up steam
key_facts: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff wrote on X on Friday 9 Oct 2026: 'The era of Super Intelligence is here. AIForce is officially SIForce.'
The rename covers Salesforce's agent platform, not the company's corporate name.
Elon Musk pledged on Sunday (4 Oct) to rename SpaceXAI as SpaceXSI.
Trump wrote on Truth Social on Thursday (8 Oct) that the White House considers anyone using 'Artificial Intelligence' instead of 'Super Intelligence' 'THE ENEMY'.
A 29 Sep executive order tells federal agencies to use 'Super Intelligence' and 'SI' in official communications, to the extent the law permits.
Private companies are not required to follow the order.
OpenAI, Scale AI, Character AI and Resolve AI did not respond to requests for comment.
quote_evidence: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff said Friday that his company's AIForce platform is getting a new name.
Private companies aren't required by the order to follow suit.
The term generally describes systems far more capable than humans across a broad range of tasks, and renaming existing products doesn't establish that they meet that threshold.
why_it_matters_hint: Executives are starting to adopt the White House wording although the order binds only federal agencies.
event_date: 9 Oct 2026 (Benioff post); continues the 8 Oct Trump post
notes: Follow-up of our 9 Oct 2026 item on the Trump post. Headline of source overstates: only the agent platform is renamed.
